provenance.unverifiedTimelines: Printed position 17 names X-Men Timelines without a number. No standalone original or association with printed position 16 has been established; keep the reference outside the whole-publication vector and return new exact identity evidence to the coordinator.
provenance.sabretoothSpecial: Printed position 23 says Sabretooth #1; the exact Road Vol. 2 bibliography identifies Sabretooth Special (1995) #1 rather than the 1993 miniseries. https://leagueofcomicgeeks.com/comic/3202804/x-men-road-to-onslaught-vol-2-tp
provenance.companions: Selected printed positions 26 and 39 are qualified 1996 #1 art/reference companions, Hot Shots: X-Men and Xavier Institute Alumni Yearbook; preserve their raw source names and confirm exact original metadata separately.
provenance.optionalPrelude: Printed positions 40-61 are optional excerpt provenance only. Six backward links refer to earlier Road issues, not selected repeats.
provenance.exclusions: Printed position 13 is an explicitly unrelated unnumbered Swimsuit reference; positions 65 and 66 name only one page from each original. Sensational Spider-Man #8 at position 76 remains a selected whole-issue candidate.
provenance.alternatives: Do not add Uncanny X-Men #335, Generation X #18-19, X-Men Unlimited #12, later Onslaught returns or a revised Prelude #282 from comments or other collections.
